# Aswini Bommadi

> Sanctions and AML compliance professional with 10+ years at JPMorgan Chase & Co, HSBC and Tata Consultancy Services. Based in Toronto, Ontario, Permanent Resident of Canada, pursuing the ACAMS CAMS certification. Open to sanctions, AML and KYC roles across Canada and the US.

Aswini (she/her) has screened and investigated payments, customers and transactions for sanctions, money-laundering and PEP risk under OFAC and regional requirements. At J.P. Morgan she made final decisions on escalated SWIFT and wire payments and led a team of 12 analysts.

Contact: the preferred way to reach Aswini is a message on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/aswini-bommadi). Email: hello@aswinilanka.com.

## Experience

- JPMorgan Chase & Co, Hyderabad, India (May 2022 – Mar 2026): Payments Lifecycle Associate, Sanctions Investigations, Team Lead (IC role). Screened about 120 live SWIFT and wire payments a day against OFAC and regional watchlists; made final decisions on L1 and L2 escalations (escalate, inquire, block, reject or cancel) in line with Financial Crime Compliance direction; applied OFAC general and specific licences; worked asset-freeze and travel-ban alerts; led 12 analysts and kept L1 error rates below 2% through four-eye checks and QA feedback.
- Tata Consultancy Services, Hyderabad, India (Oct 2019 – Apr 2022): Senior Process Associate, Transaction Monitoring (USA region). Reviewed 105 anomalous-transaction alerts a month for USAA customers at Level 0 and Level 1, escalating money-laundering cases for SAR or UAR filing.
- HSBC India, Visakhapatnam, India (Jul 2015 – Oct 2019): AML Executive, Client Screening (Canada and US regions) and AML Transaction Analyst (Canada region). Became SME within four months and the approved SME for US and Canada client screening; promoted to Assistant Manager Operations (IC role) in January 2019; trained a newly set-up team in Bangalore; no TAT or audit breaches and no backlog.
- Concentrix, India (Jul 2014 – Jul 2015): Customer Support.

## Skills

- Sanctions and screening: OFAC sanctions programs, general and specific licences, asset-freeze and travel-ban alerts, SWIFT and wire payment screening, name screening, PEP and adverse-media review
- AML and investigations: transaction monitoring, risk-based alert disposition, EDD, KYC record review, escalation, SAR/UAR support
- Tools: LexisNexis, World-Check, GSM, PSU, TM applications, MS Office
- Quality and leadership: four-eye checks, QA feedback, queue allocation, MI reporting, training and onboarding

## Education and recognition

- CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist), ACAMS: in progress
- B.Sc. in Mathematics, Electronics, Computer Science, Andhra University, India
- Top Performer awards for multiple months at Levels 1, 2 and 3; several Process Superstar awards
